<div class="card-body">
'''Lieutenant Tanbris''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].







<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タンブリス中尉</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">彼が操縦する宇宙船には配備コスト－１で宇宙船用兵器が配備できる。彼が操縦する宇宙船は戦闘力が＋２されるが、回避値が－１される。</span>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">負傷して出撃任務を解かれた元戦闘機パイロット。デス・スターの戦術士官である。優れた戦略家で、帝国軍の宇宙戦闘機の指揮を専門としている。</span>''
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Lieutenant Tanbris.

'''Card text:''' Starship weapons may be deployed at deploy cost −1 on a starship he pilots. A starship he pilots has power +2 but maneuver −1.

'''Lore:''' A former fighter pilot relieved of flight duties after an injury. He is a tactical officer on the Death Star, a skilled strategist who specializes in directing Imperial starfighters.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese text applies the maneuver reduction to a starship he pilots. The English printed card applies it to a starfighter he pilots.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Lieutenant Tanbris]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97.
